name: Antimanual – Compact AI Agent for Content, Chat & SEO Automation
author: Spider Themes

sections.description:
Antimanual is the complete AI automation agent for WordPress. Run a trained AI chatbot, schedule auto-publishing, bulk-rewrite content, generate documentation, audit SEO, monitor broken links, and automate internal linking — all from a single, lightning-fast React dashboard.

Whether you run a blog, SaaS site, WooCommerce store, or community forum, Antimanual puts repetitive tasks on autopilot.

Get started instantly or bring your own API keys. Antimanual includes free monthly credits powered by Antimanual Cloud AI, plus full zero-markup support for OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, xAI Grok, DeepSeek, and OpenCode Zen.

Antimanual includes built-in translations for Arabic, Bengali, German, English (UK), Spanish, French, Korean, Russian, and Chinese.

Antimanual Pro | Documentation | Support Forum

Video Overview

Supported AI Providers & Models

Antimanual works with the industry’s leading AI providers and validates model capabilities automatically:

  • Antimanual Cloud AI — Built-in multi-model routing with free monthly credit quota and automatic failover. No API key required to start.
  • OpenAI — GPT-5, GPT-5 Mini, GPT-4.1, and compatible models
  • Google Gemini — Gemini 3.1 Pro / Flash, Gemini 3 Pro / Flash, and Gemini 2.5 series
  • Anthropic Claude — Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Haiku 4.5
  • xAI Grok — Grok 4, Grok 3, Grok 3 Mini
  • DeepSeek — DeepSeek V4 Pro, DeepSeek V4 Flash
  • OpenCode Zen — Qwen 3.6 Plus, Kimi K2.6, MiniMax M2.7, GLM 5.1, and free community tiers

Antimanual Cloud AI & Free Credits

Start using AI features right away without creating third-party API accounts.

  • Zero Setup Required — Start chatting and generating content immediately with free monthly credits.
  • Smart Routing & Failover — Intelligent multi-model routing ensures high uptime and dependable responses.
  • Real-Time Usage Tracking — Live credit balance, monthly quotas, and low-credit notifications in your dashboard.
  • Flexible Hybrid Setup — Seamlessly connect your own custom API keys whenever you choose.

Trainable AI Chatbot — 24/7 Visitor Support

Deploy an intelligent chatbot trained on your actual WordPress content. It leverages vector embeddings from your Knowledge Base to deliver accurate, context-aware answers rather than generic AI guesses.

  • 1-Click Training — Index any post, page, or custom post type instantly.
  • Multi-Provider Support — Compatible with Cloud AI, OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Grok, DeepSeek, and OpenCode Zen.
  • Role Access Control — Restrict visibility and messaging permissions to specific roles or logged-in users (Pro Max).
  • Brand Customization — Tailor colors, avatar icons, position, greeting messages, and suggested starter questions.
  • Full-Page & Embed Options — Display as a floating widget, full-page chat via shortcode, or cross-domain iframe (Pro).
  • Leads & Conversation History — Capture visitor leads and inspect full conversation threads from the admin.
  • Free plan includes up to 60 conversations per month.

Automated Content Publishing (Auto-Posting)

Schedule AI-crafted blog posts that publish automatically to keep your site fresh and boost search rankings.

  • AI Topic Suggester — Automatically generate content calendars based on your site niche.
  • Native Gutenberg Blocks — Produces clean headings, paragraphs, lists, and tables — never unformatted blobs.
  • Customizable Tone & SEO — Select writing style, language, target keywords, and article depth.
  • Flexible Schedules — Set posting days, intervals, and optional expiration dates with automatic queue retries.
  • Free plan supports up to 2 active auto-posting schedules.

AI Post Generator

Turn a single prompt or topic into a complete, publish-ready WordPress post in seconds.

  • Complete Structure — Generates title, Gutenberg block content, excerpt, slug, categories, and tags.
  • Built-in SEO Tools — Focus keywords, meta descriptions, table of contents, and internal link suggestions.
  • Featured Images — Generate context-aware featured images directly during post creation.
  • Draft or Publish — Review content before publishing or send straight to your live blog.

FAQ Generator with Google Rich Snippet Schema

Generate targeted Q&A pairs from your knowledge base and insert them into pages with structured FAQ Schema markup.

  • Context-Driven FAQs — Generates relevant questions based on your site’s knowledge base.
  • Interactive Editing — Add, edit, reorder, or delete questions and answers before saving.
  • Gutenberg Block Integration — Inserts native accordion blocks or Advanced Accordion blocks.
  • Automatic FAQ Schema — Outputs validated JSON-LD schema for Google rich search results.

Repurpose Studio

Turn a single blog post into social media updates, newsletters, and video scripts in one click.

  • Multi-Platform Output — Generate posts for X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.
  • Email & Video Scripts — Create email newsletters, YouTube scripts, hooks, and call-to-actions.
  • Built-In Quick Presets — Ready-to-use presets for Product Launches, Summaries, Case Studies, and Tutorials.

AI Documentation Generator

Generate comprehensive, organized product documentation and help guides in minutes.

  • Guided 6-Step Wizard — Configure subject, depth, target audience, writing tone, and knowledge sources.
  • Structured Hierarchy — Generates topics, lessons, sub-lessons, tables of contents, and FAQs.
  • Ideal for Software & SaaS — Quickly create knowledge bases for products, plugins, and services.

Bulk Rewrite & Auto Update

Refresh aging articles, modernize tone, and optimize existing content across your entire site.

  • 8 Quick Presets — SEO Optimization, Content Refresh, Fix Grammar, Make Concise, Simplify, and more.
  • Gutenberg Preservation — Keeps existing block styling, layouts, and image placements intact.
  • Scheduled Auto-Updates — Set criteria (e.g. posts older than 6 months) to automatically update aging content.
  • Free plan includes 100 bulk rewrites per month.

Community Forum Automation

Integrate with Forumax to automate support and manage community forums with AI.

  • AI Auto-Replies — Generate helpful replies to new forum topics and discussions automatically.
  • Thread to Article — Convert resolved forum topics into published blog posts or knowledge base articles in one click.
  • Smart Filtering — Set minimum word thresholds and exclude specific user roles.
  • Free plan includes 100 AI forum answers and 100 topic conversions per month.

AI Search Gutenberg Block

Provide visitors with an intelligent search bar that understands intent and answers questions using your content.

  • Semantic Answers — Understands natural language queries and summarizes answers from your knowledge base.
  • Detailed Analytics — Review search queries, zero-result terms, and visitor helpfulness ratings.
  • Customizable Design — Configure colors, placeholder text, suggested prompts, and layout.

Smart Knowledge Base

The central AI brain of your website. It indexes and vectorizes your content to power the chatbot, search, and generators.

  • Instant Indexing — Add any WordPress post, page, or custom post type with a single click.
  • Intelligent Chunking — Automatically segments content into optimized vectors for high retrieval accuracy.
  • Auto-Sync (Pro) — Automatically re-indexes content whenever posts are created or updated.

AI Content Copilot (Inline Editor)

Edit and refine text directly inside the WordPress Block Editor without switching screens.

  • Toolbar “Magic Wand” — Highlight any text in a paragraph, heading, or list block to trigger AI actions.
  • Instant Transformations — Improve writing, fix grammar, adjust tone, shorten, expand, or translate.
  • Custom Instructions — Provide custom prompts directly in the editor for tailored rewrites.

AI Usage & Cost Analytics

Maintain full visibility and financial control over your site’s AI consumption.

  • Real-Time Dashboard — Monitor total requests, token volume, and estimated spend across all providers.
  • Role-Based Spending Limits — Set monthly token budgets per user role (e.g., limit Authors or Editors).
  • Detailed Breakdowns — Inspect usage by feature, AI provider, model, and individual team members.
  • CSV Data Export — Export detailed usage logs for external reporting and auditing.

Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server

Connect external AI assistants like Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and ChatGPT directly to your WordPress site.

  • Site Tools — Search knowledge base, inspect posts, create draft posts, retrieve site info, and query WooCommerce products/orders.
  • Content Workflows — Generate Post, Bulk Rewrite, FAQ Generator, Repurpose Studio and content briefs run with Antimanual’s own steps, prompts and saving, while the connected AI tool writes each step with its own model.
  • Pro: AI SEO Agent and Internal Linking — Audits, fix previews and one-step undo, title variants, schema, freshness refreshes and link suggestions, the same way.
  • Easy, Secure Connections — Sign in with OAuth, or use an application password or access token, with read-only or read-and-change access, and disconnect any tool at any time.
  • Selective Tool Exposure — Toggle individual tools on or off according to your security requirements.

Fast, Modern React Admin SPA

Manage all AI workflows inside a snappy, modern single-page interface built with React.

  • Zero Page Reloads — Fluid navigation across all tools and settings.
  • Encrypted API Keys — AES-256-CBC encryption ensures credentials are never exposed in browser code.
  • Dynamic Model Validation — Automatically detects key capabilities and filters unsupported model options.

Antimanual Pro — Unlock Limitless Power

Upgrade to Antimanual Pro for higher capacity and advanced capabilities:

  • Unlimited Usage — Removes all monthly caps on chatbot conversations, rewrites, and schedules.
  • Multimodal File Support — Process images, PDFs, audio, and video files in supported workflows.
  • Expanded Knowledge Base — Index external URLs, uploaded PDFs, raw text, and GitHub repositories.
  • Knowledge Base Auto-Sync — Automatically updates embeddings whenever content changes.
  • AI Translation in 34 Languages — Bulk translate posts with custom glossaries, frontend language switcher, and full RTL support.
  • Multilingual SEO — Dedicated /xx/ URLs, automatic hreflang tags, self-referencing canonicals, and dedicated hreflang XML sitemaps.
  • Cross-Domain Chatbot — Embed your trained chatbot on external domains, docs sites, or client platforms via iframe.
  • Batch Post Generator — Generate multiple articles simultaneously from bulk topic lists.

Antimanual Pro Max — Complete AI SEO Toolkit

Upgrade to Pro Max to unlock WordPress’s most powerful AI SEO suite:

  • SEO Agent — Comprehensive audits for On-Page SEO, Technical SEO, Performance, Accessibility, Security, and Mobile. 1-click fixes for titles, metas, image alt text, and lazy loading.
  • Bulk Site Audit & Competitor Compare — Audit up to 50 pages at once and benchmark your scores side-by-side against competitor URLs.
  • Broken Link Checker — Automated scans for 404s, broken links, and redirect chains with 1-click URL fixes.
  • Content Brief Generator — AI-researched outlines with target word counts, heading hierarchies, keywords, entities, and FAQs.
  • Content Freshness Scoring — Pinpoints decaying content and recommends update, rewrite, or pruning actions.
  • Schema Generator — Generates and validates JSON-LD structured data across 11 schema types with multi-schema support.
  • Keyword Cannibalization Detector — Detects competing pages and provides canonical and content consolidation plans.
  • Internal Linking Suite — Complete link audit, orphan page detection, visual link graph, AI-powered link suggestions, and bulk auto-linking.
  • Google & Search Engine Integrations — Connect Google APIs (Search Console, GA4, Core Web Vitals, Indexing API) and IndexNow for instant search engine indexing notifications.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services.

OpenAI API

Powers AI chatbot, knowledge base embeddings, and all content generation features when OpenAI is the selected provider. Your WordPress post content (for KB indexing), visitor chat messages, and admin-configured prompts are sent to OpenAI via your own API key. Data is transmitted only when you trigger an AI action or a visitor interacts with the chatbot/search.

  • OpenAI — Terms — Privacy

Google Gemini API

One of Antimanual’s supported AI providers. The same categories of data described for OpenAI above are sent to Google Gemini via your own API key, only when Gemini is the active provider.

  • Google AI (Gemini) — Terms — Privacy

Additional AI Providers

Depending on the provider you configure, Antimanual may also send your WordPress post content (for knowledge base indexing where supported), visitor chat messages, and admin-configured prompts to Anthropic Claude, xAI Grok, DeepSeek, or OpenCode Zen only when you trigger an AI action or a visitor interacts with the chatbot or AI search.

  • Anthropic
  • xAI
  • DeepSeek
  • OpenCode Zen

Spider Themes Notice Service

The plugin periodically fetches an admin notice from Spider Themes servers to display important announcements to site administrators. Only a standard HTTP GET request is made — no personal data, site content, or visitor information is ever transmitted.

  • Spider Themes — Terms — Privacy

Spider Themes Helpdesk (support assistant)

Antimanual admin pages show a chat button that opens the Antimanual documentation assistant hosted on the Spider Themes helpdesk (helpdesk.spiderthemes.net), so you can search the docs and ask questions without leaving WordPress.

Nothing is loaded from the helpdesk until you press the chat button. Hovering over the button only opens a network connection to the helpdesk so the chat loads faster; no data is sent. When you open it, the assistant is loaded in an iframe from https://helpdesk.spiderthemes.net/iframe-assistant/, and your browser sends the product name and the documentation section to show. If you opted in through the Freemius opt-in screen and you are the administrator who opted in, your name and email address are also sent so the support chat is pre-filled. Messages you type in the chat are sent to the helpdesk to be answered.

You can turn the assistant off under Antimanual → Configuration → General → Hide Support Chat (or with add_filter( 'atml_support_assistant_enabled', '__return_false' );).

  • Spider Themes — Terms — Privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the antimanual folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install directly from the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Antimanual > Settings in your dashboard.
  4. Get started immediately with built-in free credits via Antimanual Cloud AI, or enter your own API key for any supported provider.
  5. Add content to your Knowledge Base and enable the Chatbot — you are ready to go.
sections.faq:
What is Antimanual?

Antimanual is an all-in-one AI WordPress plugin that automates the most time-consuming parts of running a website. It includes a trainable AI chatbot, automated content publishing, bulk content rewriting, FAQ generator, documentation builder, repurpose studio, forum automation, AI-powered search, AI translation (Pro), SEO auditing tools (Pro Max), and an internal linking suite (Pro Max) — all managed from a single, fast admin dashboard.

Do I need an API key to use Antimanual?

No setup is required to get started. Antimanual includes free monthly credits powered by Antimanual Cloud AI. You can also connect your own API key from OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, xAI Grok, DeepSeek, or OpenCode Zen for direct provider billing with zero markup.

Which AI models does Antimanual support?

Antimanual currently supports seven AI providers and these built-in models: Antimanual Cloud AI — multi-model cloud routing with monthly free credits; OpenAI — GPT 5.4, GPT 5, GPT 5 Mini, GPT 4.1 Mini; Google Gemini — Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Preview, Gemini 3 Pro Preview, Gemini 3 Flash Preview, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview, Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite, Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite Preview; Anthropic Claude — Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Haiku 4.5; xAI Grok — Grok 4, Grok 3, Grok 3 Mini; DeepSeek — DeepSeek V4 Pro, DeepSeek V4 Flash; OpenCode Zen — Big Pickle, MiMo V2.5 Free, MiniMax M2.5 Free, Qwen 3.6 Plus, Qwen 3.5 Plus, Kimi K2.6, Kimi K2.5, GLM 5.1, and MiniMax M2.7. The plugin validates your API key and only shows supported models available for your account.

Can I train the chatbot on my own website content?

Yes. The free version lets you add any WordPress post or page to the knowledge base with one click. The chatbot then uses AI vector embeddings of that content to give accurate, context-specific answers — not generic AI responses. Antimanual Pro extends the knowledge base to support PDFs, external website URLs, custom text, and GitHub repositories.

Is auto-posting fully automated?

Yes. Once you set up a schedule — choosing topics, tone, language, article length, and publishing time — Antimanual generates complete Gutenberg posts and publishes them automatically. The free plan supports up to 2 active schedules; Pro removes the cap entirely.

What are the usage limits on the free version?

The free plan includes: 60 AI chatbot conversations per month, 2 auto-posting schedules, 100 bulk rewrites per month, 100 forum AI answers per month, 100 forum topic conversions per month, and 100 lifetime AI search queries. Features with no usage limits on the free plan include: Generate Post with AI, Repurpose Studio, FAQ Generator, Docs Generator and Auto Update. Upgrading to Pro removes all usage caps.

What exactly is in the Pro Max plan?

Pro Max includes everything in the free and Pro plans, plus an expanded SEO toolkit. The SEO Agent runs AI-powered audits on any internal or external page, covers On-Page SEO, Technical SEO, Performance, Accessibility, Security, and Mobile Friendliness, and can auto-fix many common issues with a single click. It also includes advanced SEO workflows like Broken Link Checker, Content Brief Generator, Content Freshness scoring, Schema Generator, Cannibalization Detector, and Google & Search Integrations (Core Web Vitals, Search Console, GA4, Indexing API, and IndexNow). The Internal Linking module provides a full link audit, AI link suggestions, bulk auto-linking, a visual site map, topic cluster builder, and anchor manager.

How does Internal Linking work?

The Internal Linking module (Pro Max) analyses all posts and pages on your site to build a complete link report — showing total posts, orphan pages, inbound/outbound link counts, average links per post, and a Link Health Score. You can then generate AI-powered internal link suggestions for any post, apply links in bulk, visualise your entire site’s link structure, and manage all anchor texts from one place.

What languages does AI Translation support?

Antimanual Pro includes AI translation for 34 languages. You can run bulk translations across all your posts, enable auto-translate on publish, add a custom glossary to protect brand terms, control tone and formality, and display a frontend language switcher. RTL languages are fully supported.

Are my translations visible to Google?

Yes. Each translated post is served on its own URL under a language prefix — for example /es/my-post/ for Spanish — and the language switcher links to those URLs so search engines can find them. Every language version outputs the full hreflang set (including x-default) plus a self-referencing canonical, and Antimanual publishes an hreflang XML sitemap at /atml-hreflang-sitemap.xml that is listed in your robots.txt. Pages that are not translated, such as archives, are marked noindex under a language prefix so they never compete with your real content.

Can I embed the chatbot on another website or domain?

Yes. Cross-domain chatbot embedding via a simple iframe embed code is included with Antimanual Pro. This lets you deploy the same trained chatbot on multiple domains, documentation sites, or client properties — without any additional configuration.

Does Antimanual integrate with community forum plugins?

Yes. Antimanual integrates with Forumax for AI-powered automatic responses to forum topics and replies. It also lets you convert closed forum threads into WordPress posts or knowledge base articles with a single click.

Is my API key stored securely?

Yes. All API keys are encrypted at rest using AES-256-CBC encryption tied to your WordPress secret keys. Keys are never sent to the browser unmasked — the admin UI shows only a masked preview with a connection status indicator.

Can I use Antimanual with Google Gemini instead of OpenAI?

Yes. You can use Google Gemini instead of OpenAI, and you can also switch to Anthropic Claude, xAI Grok, DeepSeek, or OpenCode Zen from the API Configuration page. Antimanual validates the selected provider and model, then automatically disables unsupported options so your setup stays valid.

Does Antimanual add any SEO markup automatically?

The FAQ Generator adds structured FAQ Schema markup (JSON-LD) to FAQ blocks for Google rich results. The SEO Agent (Pro Max) can auto-add missing meta descriptions, fix image alt text, add Open Graph tags, and enforce proper canonical URLs — all editable before saving.

What is the AI Content Copilot?

The AI Content Copilot adds a “Magic Wand” toolbar button to the WordPress block editor. Select any text in a paragraph, heading, or list block, choose a transformation — improve writing, fix grammar, shorten, lengthen, simplify, change tone, translate, or apply a custom instruction — and the AI rewrites it instantly without leaving the editor.

What is the MCP Server and who is it for?

The MCP (Model Context Protocol) Server turns your WordPress site into a structured tool provider for AI applications like Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and ChatGPT. Once enabled and configured with a bearer token from the Integrations settings page, external AI agents can search your knowledge base, read posts, create drafts, and fetch site information — within your chosen access level and enabled tool set. It is designed for developers and power users who want to drive their WordPress site from an AI assistant.

Can I monitor how much AI my site is consuming and at what cost?

Yes. The AI Usage & Cost Analytics dashboard shows total requests, tokens consumed, and estimated cost for any selected date range. You can break down usage by feature, AI provider, model, or individual user, view a daily trend chart, and export the full history to CSV. You can also set monthly token limits for specific user roles — such as Editors or Authors — to prevent unexpected cost overruns.

  • Improved: Broken Link Management – Scan results include one-click URL copying, post edit shortcuts, pre-filled replacements, and a searchable multi-select post type filter.
  • Improved: Post Generator – Streamlined New Post controls and dynamic section, introduction, conclusion, and FAQ counts so articles land closer to your target word count.
  • Improved: FAQ Generation – Automatically uses Advanced Accordion Block styling when that plugin is active.
  • Improved: AI Response Reliability – Stronger multi-pass repair so outlines, topics, and other structured replies parse reliably across providers.
  • Improved: Conversion Insights – Settings for behavior capture, goals, daily AI analysis, weekly digests, and retention now live in a dedicated Settings tab.
  • Improved: Google & Search Integrations – GA4 properties load automatically, Analytics and Search Console paths match more accurately, and newly published posts can be submitted to Google Indexing automatically.
  • Improved: Translation Workspace – Redesigned Translation screens with clearer progress, history, and controls.
  • Improved: Content Freshness Scoring – Freshness scores now follow the period you set in Monitoring Preferences.
  • Improved: Usage Cost Estimates – Updated pricing for GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-5.5 so Usage & Cost stays accurate.
  • Improved: Reasoning Model Performance – Tuned reasoning settings and token limits to reduce mid-generation cutoffs on long-form content.
  • Improved: Search Indexing Safety – Expanded noindex detection across Rank Math, Yoast, SEOPress, and Genesis so noindexed posts are not submitted to search engines.
  • Improved: Chatbot Follow-ups – Knowledge Base answers now use recent conversation context so follow-up questions stay on topic.
  • Fixed: Topic suggestions on an empty Knowledge Base now show a clear notice instead of a generic error.
  • Fixed: Importing HTML into the Knowledge Base now extracts readable text instead of saving raw markup.

3.9.0 (22 August 2026)

  • Added: API Call Log – Inspect every AI request under Usage & Cost, with model, tokens, duration, estimated cost, and filters by type and feature.
  • Added: Support for Gemini 3.6 Flash, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, MiMo V2.5 Free, Grok Build 0.1, and more OpenCode Zen models (including free-tier options).
  • Added: API log filters for all, successful, and failed requests, making failed AI calls easier to identify and troubleshoot.
  • Improved: AI Provider configuration now shows every provider and its models at once, with official logos and a clear default-provider indicator.
  • Improved: API keys are verified with the provider before they are stored; invalid keys are not saved, and the error appears next to the key field.
  • Improved: New Gemini and xAI setups now default to Gemini 3.6 Flash and Grok 4.5.
  • Improved: Usage cost estimates now account for cached input tokens, long-context pricing, and free-tier models, and past totals are recalculated so Overview, charts, and exports stay accurate.
  • Improved: Usage costs now match the exact model, or the longest matching model name, so cheaper variants such as GPT-5.4 Nano and Mini are billed using their own pricing instead of the parent model’s rate.
  • Improved: Failed AI requests no longer receive fabricated token counts, and successful and failed request totals are now shown separately in the Usage & Cost overview.
  • Fixed: Live Chat now shows each agent’s name and a distinct avatar when multiple agents reply in the same conversation.
  • Fixed: Model descriptions now show apostrophes correctly instead of HTML character codes.
  • Fixed: Failed API calls are now clearly marked in API logs, with the corresponding error message available in the log details.
  • Fixed: Configuration settings can now be saved without querying missing module database tables.
  • Fixed: Stored usage costs are recalculated to correct previously inflated totals caused by incorrect model-price matching.
  • Removed: Retired Gemini preview models and outdated Grok and OpenCode Zen options that no longer work with current providers.

3.8.0 (30 July 2026)

  • New: Live Chat – Added support for connecting multiple Telegram agents to a single shared Telegram bot, making it easier to manage conversations across multiple AI agents.
  • New: Added support for GPT 5.6 Sol, GPT 5.6 Terra, GPT 5.6 Luna, Gemini 3.5 Pro Preview, Claude Fable 5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Sonnet 5, Grok 4.5, Grok 4.3, Grok 4.1 Fast, MiniMax M2.5, and MiniMax M3.
  • Updated: Conversion Insights Agent Preview – Redesigned the upgrade page with a clearer step-by-step workflow, refreshed feature highlights (behavioral cohorts, segment comparison, goal tracking, and AI drop-off explanations), and value stats, consistent with the other SEO tools.
  • Improved: AI Post Generation – Significantly improved generation speed across all AI providers with parallel processing, batch generation, live job status, and more reliable background processing.
  • Improved: AI Error Handling – Added clearer error messages, smarter retry logic, and improved generation reliability.
  • Improved: Generated Posts – Added delete and bulk delete actions, fixed generation progress getting stuck, and improved the generated posts management interface.
  • Improved: AI Image Generation – Unified image saving across providers and enhanced image validation and security.
  • Improved: Content Length Accuracy – AI-generated posts now aim for a target length within your chosen word-count range, so articles land closer to the size you requested instead of running too short or too long.
  • Fixed: Resolved a TypeError that could interrupt AI post generation.
  • Fixed: Admin Menu Navigation – The category you’re currently viewing now stays clearly highlighted in the grouped admin menu.

3.7.1 (16 July 2026)

  • Improved: Admin Menu Navigation – Antimanual’s admin pages are now grouped into collapsible categories (Setup, AI Assistant, Content, Integrations, Translation, and SEO Tools) for faster navigation, and your open groups are remembered between visits.
  • Improved: AI Request Reliability – Strengthened AI request handling so simple text prompts work consistently across every connected provider.

3.7.0 (19 June 2026)

  • New: AI Content Copilot – Added an inline “Magic Wand” tool to the block editor for improving, summarizing, translating, and fixing grammar in your posts instantly.
  • New: AI Usage & Cost Analytics – Monitor your AI consumption with a detailed dashboard showing token usage, estimated costs, and trends across features and models.
  • New: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server – Turn your WordPress site into a smart tool for AI agents with a secure, token-protected MCP interface.
  • New: Per-Role AI Limits – Control your AI spending by setting monthly token caps for specific user roles (e.g., Editors, Authors).
  • New: Added support for GPT 5.5, GPT 5.4 Mini, GPT 5.4 Nano, GPT 5.3 Codex, and GPT 4.1.
  • Improved: Usage Analytics Export – You can now export your full AI usage history to CSV for deeper analysis and reporting.
  • Improved: Chatbot Moderation – Added IP-based access restriction to prevent abuse and block unwanted visitors from using the assistant.
  • Improved: Admin Reporting – Usage summaries now include average cost per request and percentage trends compared to the previous period.
  • Improved: Enhanced migration reliability with concurrency protection and lower memory usage during upgrades.
  • Improved: Reduced database load by caching embedding conversion checks and preventing unnecessary scans.

See changelog for all versions.

short_description: AI chatbot, auto-posting, bulk rewrite, docs generator, FAQ builder, forum AI, SEO tools, and llms.txt support for AI crawlers.
description:
Antimanual is the complete AI automation agent for WordPress. Run a trained AI chatbot, schedule auto-publishing, bulk-rewrite content, generate documentation, audit SEO, monitor broken links, and automate internal linking — all from a single, lightning-fast React dashboard.

Whether you run a blog, SaaS site, WooCommerce store, or community forum, Antimanual puts repetitive tasks on autopilot.

Get started instantly or bring your own API keys. Antimanual includes free monthly credits powered by Antimanual Cloud AI, plus full zero-markup support for OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, xAI Grok, DeepSeek, and OpenCode Zen.

Antimanual includes built-in translations for Arabic, Bengali, German, English (UK), Spanish, French, Korean, Russian, and Chinese.

Antimanual Pro | Documentation | Support Forum

Video Overview

Supported AI Providers & Models

Antimanual works with the industry’s leading AI providers and validates model capabilities automatically:

  • Antimanual Cloud AI — Built-in multi-model routing with free monthly credit quota and automatic failover. No API key required to start.
  • OpenAI — GPT-5, GPT-5 Mini, GPT-4.1, and compatible models
  • Google Gemini — Gemini 3.1 Pro / Flash, Gemini 3 Pro / Flash, and Gemini 2.5 series
  • Anthropic Claude — Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Haiku 4.5
  • xAI Grok — Grok 4, Grok 3, Grok 3 Mini
  • DeepSeek — DeepSeek V4 Pro, DeepSeek V4 Flash
  • OpenCode Zen — Qwen 3.6 Plus, Kimi K2.6, MiniMax M2.7, GLM 5.1, and free community tiers

Antimanual Cloud AI & Free Credits

Start using AI features right away without creating third-party API accounts.

  • Zero Setup Required — Start chatting and generating content immediately with free monthly credits.
  • Smart Routing & Failover — Intelligent multi-model routing ensures high uptime and dependable responses.
  • Real-Time Usage Tracking — Live credit balance, monthly quotas, and low-credit notifications in your dashboard.
  • Flexible Hybrid Setup — Seamlessly connect your own custom API keys whenever you choose.

Trainable AI Chatbot — 24/7 Visitor Support

Deploy an intelligent chatbot trained on your actual WordPress content. It leverages vector embeddings from your Knowledge Base to deliver accurate, context-aware answers rather than generic AI guesses.

  • 1-Click Training — Index any post, page, or custom post type instantly.
  • Multi-Provider Support — Compatible with Cloud AI, OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Grok, DeepSeek, and OpenCode Zen.
  • Role Access Control — Restrict visibility and messaging permissions to specific roles or logged-in users (Pro Max).
  • Brand Customization — Tailor colors, avatar icons, position, greeting messages, and suggested starter questions.
  • Full-Page & Embed Options — Display as a floating widget, full-page chat via shortcode, or cross-domain iframe (Pro).
  • Leads & Conversation History — Capture visitor leads and inspect full conversation threads from the admin.
  • Free plan includes up to 60 conversations per month.

Automated Content Publishing (Auto-Posting)

Schedule AI-crafted blog posts that publish automatically to keep your site fresh and boost search rankings.

  • AI Topic Suggester — Automatically generate content calendars based on your site niche.
  • Native Gutenberg Blocks — Produces clean headings, paragraphs, lists, and tables — never unformatted blobs.
  • Customizable Tone & SEO — Select writing style, language, target keywords, and article depth.
  • Flexible Schedules — Set posting days, intervals, and optional expiration dates with automatic queue retries.
  • Free plan supports up to 2 active auto-posting schedules.

AI Post Generator

Turn a single prompt or topic into a complete, publish-ready WordPress post in seconds.

  • Complete Structure — Generates title, Gutenberg block content, excerpt, slug, categories, and tags.
  • Built-in SEO Tools — Focus keywords, meta descriptions, table of contents, and internal link suggestions.
  • Featured Images — Generate context-aware featured images directly during post creation.
  • Draft or Publish — Review content before publishing or send straight to your live blog.

FAQ Generator with Google Rich Snippet Schema

Generate targeted Q&A pairs from your knowledge base and insert them into pages with structured FAQ Schema markup.

  • Context-Driven FAQs — Generates relevant questions based on your site’s knowledge base.
  • Interactive Editing — Add, edit, reorder, or delete questions and answers before saving.
  • Gutenberg Block Integration — Inserts native accordion blocks or Advanced Accordion blocks.
  • Automatic FAQ Schema — Outputs validated JSON-LD schema for Google rich search results.

Repurpose Studio

Turn a single blog post into social media updates, newsletters, and video scripts in one click.

  • Multi-Platform Output — Generate posts for X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.
  • Email & Video Scripts — Create email newsletters, YouTube scripts, hooks, and call-to-actions.
  • Built-In Quick Presets — Ready-to-use presets for Product Launches, Summaries, Case Studies, and Tutorials.

AI Documentation Generator

Generate comprehensive, organized product documentation and help guides in minutes.

  • Guided 6-Step Wizard — Configure subject, depth, target audience, writing tone, and knowledge sources.
  • Structured Hierarchy — Generates topics, lessons, sub-lessons, tables of contents, and FAQs.
  • Ideal for Software & SaaS — Quickly create knowledge bases for products, plugins, and services.

Bulk Rewrite & Auto Update

Refresh aging articles, modernize tone, and optimize existing content across your entire site.

  • 8 Quick Presets — SEO Optimization, Content Refresh, Fix Grammar, Make Concise, Simplify, and more.
  • Gutenberg Preservation — Keeps existing block styling, layouts, and image placements intact.
  • Scheduled Auto-Updates — Set criteria (e.g. posts older than 6 months) to automatically update aging content.
  • Free plan includes 100 bulk rewrites per month.

Community Forum Automation

Integrate with Forumax to automate support and manage community forums with AI.

  • AI Auto-Replies — Generate helpful replies to new forum topics and discussions automatically.
  • Thread to Article — Convert resolved forum topics into published blog posts or knowledge base articles in one click.
  • Smart Filtering — Set minimum word thresholds and exclude specific user roles.
  • Free plan includes 100 AI forum answers and 100 topic conversions per month.

AI Search Gutenberg Block

Provide visitors with an intelligent search bar that understands intent and answers questions using your content.

  • Semantic Answers — Understands natural language queries and summarizes answers from your knowledge base.
  • Detailed Analytics — Review search queries, zero-result terms, and visitor helpfulness ratings.
  • Customizable Design — Configure colors, placeholder text, suggested prompts, and layout.

Smart Knowledge Base

The central AI brain of your website. It indexes and vectorizes your content to power the chatbot, search, and generators.

  • Instant Indexing — Add any WordPress post, page, or custom post type with a single click.
  • Intelligent Chunking — Automatically segments content into optimized vectors for high retrieval accuracy.
  • Auto-Sync (Pro) — Automatically re-indexes content whenever posts are created or updated.

AI Content Copilot (Inline Editor)

Edit and refine text directly inside the WordPress Block Editor without switching screens.

  • Toolbar “Magic Wand” — Highlight any text in a paragraph, heading, or list block to trigger AI actions.
  • Instant Transformations — Improve writing, fix grammar, adjust tone, shorten, expand, or translate.
  • Custom Instructions — Provide custom prompts directly in the editor for tailored rewrites.

AI Usage & Cost Analytics

Maintain full visibility and financial control over your site’s AI consumption.

  • Real-Time Dashboard — Monitor total requests, token volume, and estimated spend across all providers.
  • Role-Based Spending Limits — Set monthly token budgets per user role (e.g., limit Authors or Editors).
  • Detailed Breakdowns — Inspect usage by feature, AI provider, model, and individual team members.
  • CSV Data Export — Export detailed usage logs for external reporting and auditing.

Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server

Connect external AI assistants like Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and ChatGPT directly to your WordPress site.

  • Site Tools — Search knowledge base, inspect posts, create draft posts, retrieve site info, and query WooCommerce products/orders.
  • Content Workflows — Generate Post, Bulk Rewrite, FAQ Generator, Repurpose Studio and content briefs run with Antimanual’s own steps, prompts and saving, while the connected AI tool writes each step with its own model.
  • Pro: AI SEO Agent and Internal Linking — Audits, fix previews and one-step undo, title variants, schema, freshness refreshes and link suggestions, the same way.
  • Easy, Secure Connections — Sign in with OAuth, or use an application password or access token, with read-only or read-and-change access, and disconnect any tool at any time.
  • Selective Tool Exposure — Toggle individual tools on or off according to your security requirements.

Fast, Modern React Admin SPA

Manage all AI workflows inside a snappy, modern single-page interface built with React.

  • Zero Page Reloads — Fluid navigation across all tools and settings.
  • Encrypted API Keys — AES-256-CBC encryption ensures credentials are never exposed in browser code.
  • Dynamic Model Validation — Automatically detects key capabilities and filters unsupported model options.

Antimanual Pro — Unlock Limitless Power

Upgrade to Antimanual Pro for higher capacity and advanced capabilities:

  • Unlimited Usage — Removes all monthly caps on chatbot conversations, rewrites, and schedules.
  • Multimodal File Support — Process images, PDFs, audio, and video files in supported workflows.
  • Expanded Knowledge Base — Index external URLs, uploaded PDFs, raw text, and GitHub repositories.
  • Knowledge Base Auto-Sync — Automatically updates embeddings whenever content changes.
  • AI Translation in 34 Languages — Bulk translate posts with custom glossaries, frontend language switcher, and full RTL support.
  • Multilingual SEO — Dedicated /xx/ URLs, automatic hreflang tags, self-referencing canonicals, and dedicated hreflang XML sitemaps.
  • Cross-Domain Chatbot — Embed your trained chatbot on external domains, docs sites, or client platforms via iframe.
  • Batch Post Generator — Generate multiple articles simultaneously from bulk topic lists.

Antimanual Pro Max — Complete AI SEO Toolkit

Upgrade to Pro Max to unlock WordPress’s most powerful AI SEO suite:

  • SEO Agent — Comprehensive audits for On-Page SEO, Technical SEO, Performance, Accessibility, Security, and Mobile. 1-click fixes for titles, metas, image alt text, and lazy loading.
  • Bulk Site Audit & Competitor Compare — Audit up to 50 pages at once and benchmark your scores side-by-side against competitor URLs.
  • Broken Link Checker — Automated scans for 404s, broken links, and redirect chains with 1-click URL fixes.
  • Content Brief Generator — AI-researched outlines with target word counts, heading hierarchies, keywords, entities, and FAQs.
  • Content Freshness Scoring — Pinpoints decaying content and recommends update, rewrite, or pruning actions.
  • Schema Generator — Generates and validates JSON-LD structured data across 11 schema types with multi-schema support.
  • Keyword Cannibalization Detector — Detects competing pages and provides canonical and content consolidation plans.
  • Internal Linking Suite — Complete link audit, orphan page detection, visual link graph, AI-powered link suggestions, and bulk auto-linking.
  • Google & Search Engine Integrations — Connect Google APIs (Search Console, GA4, Core Web Vitals, Indexing API) and IndexNow for instant search engine indexing notifications.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services.

OpenAI API

Powers AI chatbot, knowledge base embeddings, and all content generation features when OpenAI is the selected provider. Your WordPress post content (for KB indexing), visitor chat messages, and admin-configured prompts are sent to OpenAI via your own API key. Data is transmitted only when you trigger an AI action or a visitor interacts with the chatbot/search.

  • OpenAI — Terms — Privacy

Google Gemini API

One of Antimanual’s supported AI providers. The same categories of data described for OpenAI above are sent to Google Gemini via your own API key, only when Gemini is the active provider.

  • Google AI (Gemini) — Terms — Privacy

Additional AI Providers

Depending on the provider you configure, Antimanual may also send your WordPress post content (for knowledge base indexing where supported), visitor chat messages, and admin-configured prompts to Anthropic Claude, xAI Grok, DeepSeek, or OpenCode Zen only when you trigger an AI action or a visitor interacts with the chatbot or AI search.

  • Anthropic
  • xAI
  • DeepSeek
  • OpenCode Zen

Spider Themes Notice Service

The plugin periodically fetches an admin notice from Spider Themes servers to display important announcements to site administrators. Only a standard HTTP GET request is made — no personal data, site content, or visitor information is ever transmitted.

  • Spider Themes — Terms — Privacy

Spider Themes Helpdesk (support assistant)

Antimanual admin pages show a chat button that opens the Antimanual documentation assistant hosted on the Spider Themes helpdesk (helpdesk.spiderthemes.net), so you can search the docs and ask questions without leaving WordPress.

Nothing is loaded from the helpdesk until you press the chat button. Hovering over the button only opens a network connection to the helpdesk so the chat loads faster; no data is sent. When you open it, the assistant is loaded in an iframe from https://helpdesk.spiderthemes.net/iframe-assistant/, and your browser sends the product name and the documentation section to show. If you opted in through the Freemius opt-in screen and you are the administrator who opted in, your name and email address are also sent so the support chat is pre-filled. Messages you type in the chat are sent to the helpdesk to be answered.

You can turn the assistant off under Antimanual → Configuration → General → Hide Support Chat (or with add_filter( 'atml_support_assistant_enabled', '__return_false' );).

  • Spider Themes — Terms — Privacy
